column1: # What the singing facade SINGS for a number token, and how many syllables that is (W7-SD1, 2026-09-27).
# The facade (scripts/sing/singlib/phonemes.py, G2PPhonemizer.__call__) phonemizes a lyric word as
# and sings the whole result across that word's notes. Column 1 is the word, column 2 is exactly that
# pre-g2p text, column 3 is its syllable count: the stress-marked phones of each word's FIRST CMUdict
# pronunciation. EnglishSyllables.estimate(column 1) must equal column 3 on every row.
# Made with REAL g2p_en, not a re-derivation:
#   python: the p2-sing spike's venv-alt, run with -B so nothing was written into the spike;
#   g2p_en 2.1.0 and inflect 7.5.0 (the versions scripts/sing/requirements.lock pins);
#   normalize_numbers loaded from g2p_en/expand.py BY FILE PATH (sha256
#   CMUdict: the spike's NLTK copy, sha256 cad209c39eb87677d64e93d97f8eed10b7e6f9bdd42de8e7ca8efc8e17d62e8a
#   the loop, per word w:  t = normalize_numbers(w.lower()).replace("-", " ");
#     syllables = sum(stress digits of cmudict[x] for x in re.findall(r"[a-z']+", t)).
# LEFT OUT (12 rows): g2p_en sends a word that is not in CMUdict to its neural guesser, and no table can

# pin a guess: 0th (zeroth), 20s (twentys), 30s (thirtys), 40s (fortys), 50s (fiftys), 60s (sixtys), 70s (seventys), 80s (eightys), 90s (ninetys), 1950s (nineteen fiftys), 1960s (nineteen sixtys), 1990s (nineteen ninetys).
